summary.text: Blaine Watkins is a Republican member of the Iowa House of Representatives, District 100, who took office on March 24, 2025, succeeding Martin Graber, and is seeking election on November 3, 2026. He lives in Donnellson and has worked as a legislative aide.

paragraphs.text: Blaine Watkins was born in Donnellson, Iowa, where he lives, and earned a bachelor's degree from Grand View University in 2024.
His career experience includes working as a state senate clerk and secretary.
For 2025-2026 he serves on the House Judiciary and House Local Government committees.
He advanced from the June 2, 2026 Republican primary and faces Democrat Matt Mohrfeld in the general election.
